ProjectWeave request for the selected Task (data):
{"task": {"id": "I_kwDOVQjqe88AAAABZXbSsA", "item_id": "PVTI_lAHOAHSLSM4Bn3INzhC-uy4", "project_id": "PVT_kwHOAHSLSM4Bn3IN", "number": 65, "title": "Add a retained DAISIZEN conference reading and contribution journey", "body": "## Problem

At baseline `317c9bb89ba397b3dc4b5460fa346df69cf0c5b8`, enter `13 → 2 → CONFERENCE`. The service displays `参加者：0人` and permits redisplay/return, but offers no contributions to read or write. `src/sections.ts` maps `CONFERENCE` to `room`; `src/navigation.ts` provides no conference content context.

This advances an intentionally limited placeholder from Issues #13/#33. It is not a regression in their implementation. The current representation misses evidenced conference message activity and obscures the distinction from OLT.

## Expected outcome

Provide one small browser-local electronic conference, separate from DAISIZEN’s numbered forums and OLT:

`DAISIZEN → CONFERENCE → contribution list → read → write/reply → review/edit → submit → list/read → leave → re-enter/reload`.

A fresh starter world contains a short original Japanese discussion. Existing/imported worlds without conference data remain empty and support a first human contribution. Reading requires neither registration nor AI consent; writing uses the existing local human identity flow.

## Context

### Historical evidence and reconstruction decision

Sources inspected on 2026-10-23:

- The [DAISIZEN operator memorial](https://www.chayagate.com/daisizen/index.htm) lists electronic conference separately from forums and OLT. Confidence is high in this preserved distinction; the directory is undated and does not establish the exact 1996 configuration. Its retained mountain forum and account of a 1992 split remain inconsistent.
- The publisher’s [Internet Magazine October 1994 article, printed page 104](https://iwparchives.jp/wp-content/themes/twentytwelve/bn/pdf/im199410-104-bbs.pdf) describes reading others’ conference messages, contributing messages and their retention on the host, explicitly discussing services including PC-VAN. This is strong contemporary evidence for general retained-message semantics, not DAISIZEN controls. PDF text was inspected; screenshot retrieval failed.
- An [author-preserved PC-VAN course archive](https://someya.sakura.ne.jp/poem/tansi/tansimain.html) contains an administrative notice dated 1996-08-07 directing contributions to a forum or a separately numbered electronic conference. This supplies target-year evidence that conferences were places to publish contributions distinct from forums. It concerns another SIG; do not transplant its names, numbering, posting restrictions or member identities.
- The [まいとーく client-author description](https://www.vector.co.jp/soft/win95/net/se024554.html) includes conference unread reading/writing and separately describes OLT attendance and participation. Its release date remains unresolved, and grouped client capabilities do not authenticate host sequences.
- An [indexed PCVAN_DL.PRO listing](https://search.vector.co.jp/vsearch/vsearch.php?kanji=euc&key=PR&start=1170) dates version 1.08 to 1996-08-15 and describes conference retrieval/writing. Direct retrieval failed: this is supporting catalog evidence only. The [participation guide](https://www.chayagate.com/daisizen/sig_list.htm) also remained inaccessible; accessible alternatives above allow useful progress.

Accept retained reading and contribution as a high-confidence general service model. DAISIZEN’s exact topic organization, controls, prompts, attendance rules and moderation remain unknown. Reconstruct one conference and its original discussion; do not claim to recover its historical configuration. Existing application conventions `LIST`, `READ number`, `WRITE`, `REPLY number` and composer controls are acceptable category-D reconstruction. Keep these qualifications in About/research rather than repeating them in routine terminal output.

### Implementation boundaries and history

- Inspect `src/navigation.ts`, `src/commands.ts`, `src/main.ts`, `src/composer.ts`, `src/storage/repository.ts` and `src/storage/schema.ts`. `TerminalComposer` already supports generic destinations, review/edit/cancel and a save callback; reuse suitable behavior without broad refactoring.
- Current forum storage resolves by SIG keyword and numeric board number. Do not alias conference records to an existing board. `src/ai/activity.ts` considers stored forums as potential activity targets; reusing those record types must not accidentally enable conference AI posting. The validated settings-backed OLT state is another existing persistence pattern to consider.
- `tests/services.spec.ts` currently expects the participant placeholder and rejects conference reads. Replace those obsolete assertions while preserving the other services’ coverage.
- Closed [Issue #13](https://github.com/takahirox/pcvan/issues/13) established qualified entries; closed [Issue #33](https://github.com/takahirox/pcvan/issues/33) established useful empty destinations. [Issue #59](https://github.com/takahirox/pcvan/issues/59) populated library/OSL browsing. Live open-Issue/PR searches returned no results.
- [PR #64](https://github.com/takahirox/pcvan/pull/64) and `docs/validation.md` record 234 passing tests including TypeScript checking and production build. These are Coordinator records, not checks run by this research graph. The review endpoint returned an empty list, which does not establish absence of other review.

Scope excludes conference AI generation, live attendance, moderation, transfers, other information services and the general historical presentation calendar.

## Pre-merge acceptance

- [ ] `CONFERENCE` opens a contribution list labeled as electronic conference, with useful empty behavior. `READ number` displays a contribution in the same conference context; `LIST`/`HELP` redisplay its list, `BACK` returns to DAISIZEN, and `MAIN` clears nested navigation. Invalid commands/numbers leave context intact. Conference does not show OLT attendance or accept OLT speech controls.
- [ ] Fresh starter worlds contain at least three original Japanese contributions forming one coherent nature-community discussion, using at least two existing fictional residents. Include one explicit reply relationship. Do not copy archived prose, poems, real identities or images. Fictional topic organization is documented as reconstruction.
- [ ] Seed examples only into freshly created starter worlds. Opening an existing world, importing an older backup without conference records, or restoring an intentionally empty conference must not insert examples or fall back to hidden demo content. These worlds can submit their first human contribution. Preserve current reset/reseed semantics.
- [ ] `WRITE` and `REPLY number` use the selected local human, with the existing optional registration path when needed. Support title/multiline body, review, editing, explicit confirmation and cancellation. Navigation commands cannot silently discard or submit a draft. Invalid/missing reply parents produce a useful error without saving; storage failure retains retryable input. Repeated confirmation cannot duplicate a contribution.
- [ ] Persist contributions, stable identities, ordered per-conference numbers and same-conference reply references transactionally. Re-entry/reload retains submissions. Existing JSON backup/import includes conference data with validation and rollback; older backups remain valid. Test concurrent numbering and reject invalid references. Preserve stored timestamps and existing scheduling semantics.
- [ ] Conference storage and routing remain distinct from numbered SIG boards, mail, OLT and library/OSL. Browsing and cancellation do not create contributions or repopulate user collections. If forum record types are reused, explicitly prevent accidental conference selection by existing forum AI planning. Preserve inference consent, private-context boundaries, backup/reset confirmations and stale-world handling. Ordinary conference use needs no model, download, backend or external delivery.
- [ ] Preserve literal-text rendering, Japanese whitespace, IME submission guards, keyboard operation, narrow-screen scrolling, pacing/skip and Settings return context. Retain existing functional, storage, consent, IME and terminal regression coverage.
- [ ] Extend the existing Playwright/controller/repository coverage for the complete fresh-world journey, anonymous reading, first contribution in an empty older/imported world, reply/edit/cancel, failed save/retry, invalid commands, return/re-entry, reload, backup round-trip, empty restoration, numbering and service/AI isolation. Include a production-browser conference journey using existing helpers and tooling.
- [ ] Update affected usage, About/evidence metadata and research documentation with commands, original-content provenance, inspection dates, confidence and unresolved host behavior. Remove stale claims that conference is participant-only. The Coordinator runs documented `npm test` before merge; its existing configuration includes TypeScript checking and the production build. Record actual results and review the final diff/whitespace. No new framework or model inference is required.

## Optional validation

Additional accessible period manuals or genuine DAISIZEN conference logs may refine the reconstruction. They are not a completion gate. Human, hardware and real-model checks are not required.

## Required post-merge verification

None required. The Coordinator can verify this scope against local production assets before merge.
